corrected.statement: In 0.16.0 the storage version of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1 (v1beta1 storage true → false). v1beta1 is still served. Existing objects keep working and stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. This is a review item, not mandatory work.

decision.reason: [ev-a93bb3b1d26d] shows only that the v1beta1 storage flag of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io goes from true to false in 0.16.0, so v1 becomes the storage version, and v1beta1 is still served in the target release [ev-e08924afdc47]. Nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in this release. The change text ties the storage migration only to "a later release" that removes v1beta1, and no evidence says that removal is scheduled. Calling this mandatory migration-required work overstates it: existing objects keep working and are stored as v1 when they are rewritten, so this is a behavior-change to review, with the migration as advisable preparation.
